item.title: Collingwood Cost of Living 2026: Real Prices, Real Talk
item.description:
Updated 16 March 2026 | Marcus Cole reporting

Collingwood in 2026 is the suburb Melbourne can’t stop arguing about. Half the city swears it’s still the cheap, gritty inner-north option. The other half just paid $650 a week for a one-bedroom on Smith Street and is quietly having a crisis.

The truth, as usual, sits somewhere in the middle — but it’s creeping closer to “expensive” with every quarter. Collingwood’s cost of living has shifted noticeably since 2024, and if you’re thinking about moving here, already here, or just trying to figure out whether your pay rise actually kept up with your rent, this is the article for you.

If you’re thinking about moving here, or you already live here and want to know where your money’s actually going, let’s crunch the real numbers.

item.title: Cost of Living in Footscray 2026: The Real Numbers

We did the legwork. Real prices. Real rent. Real coffee. What you’ll actually spend in a month living in Footscray in 2026.

item.title: Cost of Living in Kensington 2026: The Real Numbers

Kensington is one of those suburbs where everyone has an opinion and nobody checks the maths. So let’s do what nobody does and put actual numbers on it. Not vibes. Not “it depends.” Real 2026 AUD figures for what it costs to actually live in Kensington, postcode 3031, right now.

item.title: Cost of Living in Melbourne 2026: The Real Numbers
item.description:
Cost of Living in Melbourne 2026: The Real Numbers

Updated 16 March 2026 | Alex Petrova reporting

Melbourne’s cost of living has become a punchline at dinner parties. You know the one — someone mentions their rent went up again, the table groans in unison, and someone says “maybe Adelaide.” But what does it actually cost to live here, right now, in March 2026?

We pulled the numbers. Not vibes, not vibes-based budgeting — real data from Numbeo, Domain, Homes Victoria, the ABS, and the transport affordability research published by the Australian Automobile Association. Here’s what your money buys you in Melbourne this year, broken down by every category that matters.

item.title: Cost of Living in Melbourne CBD 2026: The Real Numbers
item.description:
Cost of Living in Melbourne CBD 2026: The Real Numbers

Updated 16 March 2026 | Marcus Cole reporting

Living in the CBD isn’t cheap. Nobody moved here thinking it would be. But there’s a difference between “not cheap” and “I need to understand exactly where my money goes before I sign a 12-month lease on a shoebox in a tower with zero natural light.”

This is that difference.

We’ve pulled real 2026 numbers — rent, groceries, transport, coffee, dining, gym, utilities, and the stuff nobody talks about — so you can decide whether CBD living is worth it for you. Not for a hypothetical person on a hypothetical salary. For you, right now, with your actual bank account.

item.title: Cost of Living in South Yarra 2026: The Real Numbers
item.description:
Cost of Living in South Yarra 2026: The Real Numbers

South Yarra. The postcode that makes renters wince and brunch-goers weep with joy. Sitting pretty along Chapel Street’s flashiest stretch, wedged between Prahran to the south and Richmond across the river, with Toorak peering down from its hill of inherited wealth — South Yarra is Melbourne’s most aspirational inner-city suburb that doesn’t require a trust fund to call home. Almost.

We ran the actual numbers. Not the sanitized “you could live here if you’re frugal” figures that real estate agents love to quote. The real ones. What it actually costs to live in South Yarra in 2026, where every flat white feels like a small act of defiance against your savings account.

item.title: Cost of Living in St Kilda 2026: The Real Numbers
item.description:
Cost of Living in St Kilda 2026: The Real Numbers

Updated 16 March 2026 | Marcus Cole reporting

St Kilda. The suburb that makes you fall in love with Melbourne and then charges you accordingly for the privilege. After eight years watching this market from the inside — as a renter, a buyer’s advocate, and someone who’s called this patch of bayside chaos home for three of those years — I can tell you this: St Kilda in 2026 is more expensive than you think, less insane than you’ve heard, and absolutely not for everyone.

item.title: Cost of Living in St Kilda East 2026: The Real Numbers

Cost of Living in St Kilda East 2026: The Real Numbers

It’s quieter than its famous neighbour, cheaper than people expect, and has a density of Eastern European bakeries that would make Budapest jealous. But does it actually stack up as a place to live in 2026? We did the maths so you don’t have to.

item.title: Richmond Cost of Living 2026: Real Prices, Real Talk
item.description:
Richmond Cost of Living 2026: Real Prices, Real Talk

Richmond. The suburb where a $7 flat white sits three blocks from a $1.80 lamington at the Richmond Milk Bar. Where a $1.6 million terrace sits next to a housing commission tower. Where you can watch the footy for free from your balcony on game day — then cop a $45 Uber surge trying to leave.

This is not a lifestyle guide. This is a bank balance reality check.
